changeSet.author: druchek
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO answer_attempt (answer_option_id, question_id, student_attempt_id, provided_text, is_answer_correct) SELECT ao.ao_id, qn.id, sa.id, NULL, CASE WHEN ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 2 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM student_attempt sa INNER JOIN task_quiz tq ON sa.task_id = tq.task_id INNER JOIN question qn ON qn.quiz_id = tq.quiz_id CROSS APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 ao2.id AS ao_id FROM answer_option ao2 WHERE ao2.question_id = qn.id ORDER BY NEWID() ) ao WHERE tq.task_id IN (SELECT id FROM task WHERE title LIKE 'mock[_]task[_]%');

rollback.sql: DELETE aa FROM answer_attempt aa INNER JOIN student_attempt sa ON aa.student_attempt_id = sa.id INNER JOIN task t ON sa.task_id = t.id WHERE t.title LIKE 'mock[_]task[_]%';
